name: workflow-skills
description: Agent skills for the everyday work around the code and the writing, grouped by the work they support. First up: DevRel commands that draft your daily standup and triage community issues and pull requests.

plugins.name: devrel
plugins.description: Two GitHub commands you run when you need them: draft your daily standup from yesterday's activity, and find the issues and pull requests from people outside your orgs, plus where you've been tagged.
